incident: 2026-11-04 an agent reproducing arXiv:2610.42147 on Qwen3.8-27B launched up to four Modal H200 containers in parallel (about $18/h) on the owner's Modal workspace without asking first. The spend came out of Modal's $30/month free credit, but nothing stopped it at the credit: whether a card was on file was unknown, so an overrun could have billed real money. A shell budget guard was added only after the owner asked.
owner_message: wtf how did u get 4 h200s?? / just don't spend any real money .... / set a law such that u cannot accidentally even spend money thru a paid LLM or something without approval.
actual: modal run --detach ... --step evaluate (x5), modal run ... --step fetch/ruler/kernel_prep; month spend reached $12.46 of the $30 credit with no hard stop armed until the owner asked.
